$comment: Contract for the SetPermissionRuleActive server-side command (AD-003, AD-041, AD-037/OD-010). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_SetPermissionRuleActive). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_SetPermissionRuleActive
customApi.description: Withdraws or restores an al_pagepermission override rule. Withdrawing drops the override so the role falls back to the code default; to deny explicitly, set the rule level to None instead. Enforces permission.manage Manage and writes an immutable Audit Event (BR-012).

requestParameters.name: PermissionId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_pagepermission record to withdraw or restore.

requestParameters.name: Active
requestParameters.description: True to restore the rule, false to withdraw it.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.
